While cats are obligate carnivores and require a diet rich in protein, there are some human foods that can be safely given to them in moderation. One such food is cooked chicken, but what about flowers? Yes, you read that right - flowers! Specifically, lilies are a popular choice among cat owners who want to give their pets a special treat. However, it's essential to note that not all lilies are safe for cats, so make sure to choose the right variety. The Easter lily, for example, is toxic to cats and should be avoided at all costs. On the other hand, the daylily and tiger lily are non-toxic and can be given to your cat in small amounts. Just be sure to remove any pollen or leaves, as these can cause stomach upset. So, go ahead and give your cat a little something extra - just remember to do it safely and in moderation.
